shipped_rows.title_o: Improving Teachers’ Knowledge of Functional Assessment-based Interventions: Outcomes of a Professional Development Series
shipped_rows.authors_o: Lane; Oakes; Powers; Diebold; Germer; Common; Brunsting

blind_target.evidence_quote: In this replication study, we examined the effect of educators’ participation in a practice-based professional learning series for designing, implementing, and evaluating Functional Assessment-based Interventions (FABI; Umbreit, Liaupsin, Ferro, & Lane, 2007) on their actual knowledge and perceived knowledge, confidence, and usefulness of concepts taught.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Consistent with earlier inquiry, results indicated participants demonstrated statistically significant improvements in the constructs measured.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The abstract explicitly compares improvements with the earlier inquiry; the target citation is not identifiable in the available abstract. The Umbreit citation identifies the intervention approach, not demonstrably the earlier evaluation.

luna_triage.reason: The abstract identifies an earlier inquiry about improvements in educators’ knowledge, confidence, and perceived usefulness, but does not name the report or give reference-list details. Shipped row 100 is a related 2015 professional-development study by Lane and colleagues, yet the supplied abstract does not establish that it is the earlier inquiry being retested rather than another study of the same intervention. Needed evidence: the replication’s reference list and primary description of the earlier inquiry, sufficient to identify whether row 100 reports that finding.
